WITH ping AS (
                UPDATE v2_job_runtime SET ping = null WHERE id = $2
            ), place AS (
                UPDATE concurrency_key SET original_scheduled_for = COALESCE(
                    original_scheduled_for,
                    (SELECT scheduled_for FROM v2_job_queue WHERE id = $2)
                )
                WHERE job_id = $2
            )
            UPDATE v2_job_queue SET
                running = false,
                started_at = null,
                scheduled_for = $1
            WHERE id = $2
